subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures be reported through the existing accepted-then-async run path with a terminal startup failure state, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight sandbox startup before returning accepted?
rationale: Both shapes can address the user-visible hang, but the choice changes lifecycle events, registry state, gateway wait behavior, and the relationship to the broader startup-silence issue.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

options.title: Preflight Sandbox Before Accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation ahead of the accepted response so failures reject immediately, accepting latency and compatibility implications for existing callers.

options.title: Defer To Broader Lifecycle Work
options.body: Treat the broader lifecycle issue and replacement implementation as the design owner, while keeping this issue as the sandbox-specific live proof case.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted async spawn contract, but emit/log a typed startup failure and prove registry, session history, and subagents list callers see it for Docker sandbox startup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent and broad history across subagent lifecycle, registry, and terminal-state paths touched by the decision.
